Let me analyze this ticket.

Jennifer Miller (E017) requests write access to Source Code.

Two notes:
- Note 1 (HR?): role Analyst, employment type full_time, recommendation write. Says max is write for full-time, Analyst doesn't own Source Code (Engineer owns it), so write is fine.
- Note 2 (Security): role Analyst, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Says Security DB is authoritative for employment type; contractor with basic training => max read. Requested write is above max, so recommend read.

Conflict: employment type - full_time vs contractor. Security note says Security DB is authoritative for employment type. So the employee is a contractor with basic security training.

Contractor policy: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training => max read.

Requested write is above max read, so grant maximum = read.

So decision: read.

I should submit read with reasoning.
